bull.b: Term-based subscriptions create recurring revenue visibility, while broader functionality, additional users and geographic expansion can increase customer spend. This model supports durable cash generation and gives Zscaler multiple avenues to deepen relationships over the next several quarters.

Strong growth alongside larger enterprise deployments indicates expanding adoption rather than reliance only on smaller customers. Rising high-value accounts and record million-dollar deals can improve revenue durability, customer concentration quality and cross-selling potential.

Robust operating and free cash flow provides internal funding for product investment, infrastructure and market expansion despite accounting losses. Consistently high gross margins and improving EBITDA also indicate meaningful operating leverage as the platform scales.

bear.b: Continued negative EBIT and net income show that the transition from strong cash generation to durable GAAP profitability is unfinished. The company must sustain margin improvement and manage operating costs effectively for earnings quality to strengthen.

Expected growth is materially below fiscal 2026’s 25% pace while infrastructure investment remains elevated. This combination could reduce near-term free-cash-flow conversion and raises the execution burden of converting AI and platform initiatives into sustained returns.

Higher MDR-related churn can pressure retention and dilute the quality of acquired growth, while sales leadership changes may temporarily slow execution in affected regions. Together, these issues create risks to expansion rates and the pace of platform integration.
